title: SAP Developer - SOX (Remote)
description:
Olá!


A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:

Desenvolvedor SAP com Conhecimento em Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolvimento SAP (ABAP/ABAP OO, UI5/Fiori, SAP HANA, S/4HANA) com foco em qualidade, performance e segurança;
  • Análise de requisitos de negócios e tradução em soluções técnicas alinhadas a controles internos e SOX;
  • Implementação e manutenção de controles de TI e controles de processos para SOX (separação de funções, trilha de auditoria, controles de acesso, change management);
  • Desenvolvimento de relatórios e dashboards para evidenciar conformidade, incluindo evidências de auditoria e testes de controles;
  • Colaboração com equipes de Compliance, Auditoria e GRC para mapear riscos, criar controles e gerar evidências de conformidade;
  • Gestão de mudanças (change management) com documentação, aprovações, testes e rollback.
  • Análise de riscos, mapeamento de processos e melhoria de controles internos;
  • Construção de documentação técnica e de governança, incluindo padrões de coding, revisão de pares e trilha de auditoria.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento SAP (ABAP/ABAP OO, SAP UI5/Fiori, HANA), preferencialmente em S/4HANA;
  • Conhecimento sólido de Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) e controles de TI/processos aplicáveis a ambientes SAP;
  • Familiaridade com auditoria de TI, GRC/SOX, gestão de mudanças, gestão de acessos e trilha de auditoria;
  • Capacidades de testes: unitários, integração e testes de controles. Habilidade de documentação técnica clara para auditorias.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de Dono;
  • Foco no Cliente;
  • Proativo, orientado a resultados e com boa comunicação entre business e TI;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma e em equipe, com foco em qualidade e conformidade;
  • Atenção a detalhes, organização e visão de longo prazo de governança.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com SAP GRC, SAP Access Control, SAP Process Control;
  • Certificações em Compliance/Segurança da Informação;
  • Experiência em projetos de migração/implementação com foco em governança e controle.

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Gympass

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

title: Responsable de l'impact dans la filière açaí en Amazonie brésilienne VIE basé à Belém, Brésil / Gerente de Impacto, Cadeia de Suprimentos do Açaí, Amazônia Brasileira (baseado em Belém, Brasil)
description:
POUR CANDIDATER :

Envoyer CV et lettre de motivation à avant le 31/09/2025


Nous sommes une jeune entreprise en pleine croissance basée à Paris et à Belém dans l’état du Pará au Brésil, qui développe des produits alimentaires bio et sains à base d’açaí. Nous travaillons directement avec des petits producteurs brésiliens pour avoir un impact social et environnemental positif sur cette région fragile. Nous commercialisons nos produits en France et à l’export dans les restaurants, supermarchés, magasins bio et auprès des industriels. Entrer chez Nossa! c’est intégrer une équipe jeune, dynamique, et créative. C’est aussi prendre part à un projet qui vise à promouvoir une alimentation saine tout en ayant un fort impact social et environnemental en Amazonie. Nous valorisons la diversité et l’inclusion. Aucun critère de sexe, d’origine, d’âge, de religion, d’orientation sexuelle ou de situation de handicap ne sera discriminant dans le processus de sélection. Seules les compétences et la motivation seront prises en compte.


MISSIONS :

Le poste est basé à Belém, dans le Nord du Brésil. L’équipe se compose de la cheffe de pôle RSE, d’un technicien agricole, et de consultants aux missions spécifiques. Tu prendras la suite de l’actuelle cheffe de pôle RSE, et jouiras d’une grande autonomie. En contact direct avec le fondateur, tu organises nos relations avec les coopératives de producteurs et les usines de transformation en pulpe d’açaí. Ces relations incluent en particulier la mise en œuvre de notre stratégie d’impact socio-environnemental auprès des producteurs en agroforesterie pour leur permettre de s’adapter aux changements climatiques, améliorer leur production d’açaí et diversifier leurs sources de revenus. L’açaí pousse naturellement sur les bordures de rivières, dans des parcelles agroforestières entretenues par les populations locales appelées « ribeirinhos ». Un enjeu fort du travail de Nossa! avec les producteurs est de contribuer au maintien ou à l’augmentation de la biodiversité tout en améliorant la production et les conditions de travail.


A/ Mise en œuvre de notre stratégie d’impact et renfort de nos partenariats avec les coopératives


Avec l’équipe locale de Nossa! tu mènes les projets ci-dessous :


1. Tu coordonnes l’équipe locale qui apporte un appui technique aux producteurs pour garantir des pratiques agricoles durable en partenariat avec des centres de recherches et agences publiques brésiliennes (conception de programmes de formations en gestion forestière, agroforesterie, apiculture…)

2. Tu accompagnes les producteurs dans leur structuration en coopératives

3. Tu travailles avec les coopératives partenaires pour identifier et coordonner des projets sociaux qui visent à améliorer la qualité de vie des familles de producteurs, en particulier sur la santé et la sécurité au travail, les questions sociales (égalité des sexes, éducation, etc.) et la gestion financière.

4. Tu accompagnes les certifications bio et prochainement commerce équitable

5. Tu mesures et suis nos indicateurs d'impact : biodiversité (via des inventaires forestiers), revenus (via des enquêtes terrain), surfaces restaurées…

6. Tu cherches et gères les financements reçus par Nossa! et tu communiques sur nos indicateurs d’impact auprès de nos financeurs

7. Tu recrutes de nouveaux collaborateurs pour agrandir l’équipe et faire grandir notre impact.


Résultats attendus d'ici 2030

• 600 petits producteurs ont été formés

• Le revenu des petits producteurs a augmenté de 100 % via la diversification des sources de revenus, l’augmentation des rendements agricoles, et un meilleur prix d’achat

• 3000 hectares sont gérés durablement

• 100% de nos producteurs sont certifiés bio et commerce équitable


B/ Gestion des risques environnementaux et sociaux


Tu améliores notre SGES (Système de Gestion Environnementale et Sociale) qui comprend :

• Révision de l’inventaire des risques et mise en œuvre des procédures de gestion des risques

• Politiques (SST, contre le travail des enfants, la déforestation, l’égalité des genres…)

• Mécanisme de réclamations

• Plan d'engagement des parties prenantes


Le SGES nous permet d'identifier, de surveiller, de gérer, et d’atténuer les risques sociaux et environnementaux liés à notre activité.


C/ Gestions des achats de fruits et production de pulpe durant la récolte (d’août à décembre)


1. Tu achètes l’açaí à nos coopératives partenaires : définition du prix, des volumes, paiement

2. Tu organises la livraison des fruits à l’usine avec un sous-traitant en transport

3. Tu t’assures d’une traçabilité irréprochable entre la parcelle et l’usine


PROFIL :

Aspects indispensables :

• Tu parles couramment portugais et anglais

• Tu es ingénieur agronome ou forestier et/ou a déjà travaillé avec des petits producteurs dans des pays en développement

• Tu aimes travailler dans un contexte interculturel

• Tu as un forte capacité d’adaptation

• Tu es autonome et proactif, tu aimes proposer de nouvelles idées

• Tu es curieux, aimes apprendre et toucher à tout

• Tu aimes résoudre les problèmes, tu sais gérer la pression et l’urgence

• Tu aimes aller sur le terrain (travail en forêt et nuits chez l’habitant)

• Tu es êtes rigoureux et analytique


INFOS PRATIQUES :

• Vérifiez votre éligibilité au contrat VIE : (notamment avoir moins de 29 ans au démarrage de mission)

• Poste en coworking à Belém

• Durée de 6 mois renouvelable jusqu’à 2 ans

• Prise de poste souhaitée le 1er janvier 2026 au plus tard, pour permettre une période de tuilage d’un mois minimum avec l’actuelle cheffe de pôle RSE

• Nombreux déplacements dans les communautés de producteurs, il est donc indispensable d’être à l’aise avec les déplacements en bateau (petites embarcations traditionnelles appelées « rabeta »)

• Rémunération selon le barème VIE en vigueur pour le nord du Brésil

• Jours de congés selon les conditions du VIE


PROCESS DE RECRUTEMENT :

1. Envoyer CV et lettre de motivation à avant le 25/09/2025

2. Entretien téléphonique de 20mn

3. Entretien complet de 2h

4. Appel de références


Português


  • Enviar CV e carta de motivação para até 31/09/2025


Quem somos

Somos uma jovem empresa em pleno crescimento, com sedes em Paris e em Belém, no estado do Pará, Brasil. Desenvolvemos produtos alimentícios orgânicos e saudáveis à base de açaí – uma fruta amazônica com inúmeros benefícios para a saúde.

Trabalhamos diretamente com pequenos produtores brasileiros para gerar impacto social e ambiental positivo em uma região frágil e estratégica.


Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão. Nenhum critério de sexo, origem, idade, religião, orientação sexual ou deficiência será discriminante no processo de seleção. Apenas competências e motivação serão levadas em conta.


MISSÕES

A equipe atual é composta pela coordenadora de RSE/ESG (Responsabilidade Social e Ambiental), um técnico agrícola e consultores em missões específicas.

Você assumirá a posição de coordenador(a) de RSE, com grande autonomia e contato direto com o fundador.

Sua missão principal será fortalecer a relação com cooperativas de produtores e usinas de processamento de açaí , com foco na implementação da nossa estratégia socioambiental , apoiando produtores em sistemas agroflorestais para:

  • se adaptarem às mudanças climáticas,
  • melhorarem sua produção de açaí,
  • diversificarem suas fontes de renda.


A. Implementação da estratégia de impacto e fortalecimento de parcerias com cooperativas

Com a equipe local da Nossa!, você irá:

  • Coordenar a equipe que oferece assistência técnica aos produtores, garantindo práticas agrícolas sustentáveis em parceria com centros de pesquisa e órgãos públicos (programas de capacitação em manejo florestal, agrofloresta, meliponicultura, etc.).
  • Apoiar a organização dos produtores em cooperativas.
  • Trabalhar com cooperativas parceiras na identificação e coordenação de projetos sociais voltados à melhoria da qualidade de vida das famílias (saúde e segurança no trabalho, igualdade de gênero, educação, gestão financeira, etc.).
  • Apoiar certificações orgânicas e, futuramente, de comércio justo.
  • Medir e acompanhar indicadores de impacto (biodiversidade, renda, áreas restauradas, etc.).
  • Captar e gerir financiamentos recebidos pela Nossa!, além de comunicar indicadores de impacto a financiadores.


Resultados esperados até 2030:

  • 600 pequenos produtores formados
  • Renda dos produtores aumentada em 100%
  • 3.000 hectares manejados de forma sustentável
  • 100% dos produtores certificados em orgânico e comércio justo

B. Gestão de riscos socioambientais

Aprimorar nosso SGAS (Sistema de Gestão Ambiental e Social) , que inclui:

  • Revisão do inventário de riscos e implementação de procedimentos de gestão
  • Políticas internas (SST, combate ao trabalho infantil, combate ao desmatamento, igualdade de gênero, etc.)


C. Gestão de compras de frutos e produção de polpa durante a safra (agosto a dezembro)

  • Comprar o açaí das cooperativas parceiras (definição de preço, volume, pagamentos).
  • Organizar a logística de entrega dos frutos para a usina.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade total entre a parcela e a usina.


PERFIL


  • Fluência em português
  • Formação em engenharia agronômica ou florestal, ou experiência relevante com pequenos produtores em países em desenvolvimento
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em contextos interculturais
  • Forte capacidade de adaptação e gosto por desafios
  • Autonomia, proatividade e criatividade
  • Curiosidade, vontade de aprender e polivalência
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas, lidar com pressão e situações de urgência
  • Gosto pelo trabalho de campo (incluindo pernoites em comunidades)
  • Rigor e capacidade analítica


INFORMAÇÕES PRÁTICAS

  • Duração: 6 meses, renovável
  • Início: até 1º de janeiro de 2026 (com 1 mês de transição com a atual coordenadora)
  • Muitos deslocamentos em comunidades ribeirinhas
  • Remuneração mensal (7000 - 10000r$ dependendo do perfil)

PROCESSO SELETIVO

  • Enviar CV e carta de motivação para até 25/09/2025
  • Entrevista telefônica de 20 min
  • Entrevista completa de 2h
  • Checagem de referências

title: Estagiário
description:
Vaga de Estágio em M&A (Fusões e Aquisições) – Zaxo M&A Partners


Tipo de trabalho: Remoto


Descrição da Empresa:


A Zaxo M&A Partners se destaca como uma das principais boutiques de Fusões e Aquisições do Brasil. Com um histórico sólido de mais de duas décadas de experiência, acumulamos um volume de transações que ultrapassa os R$7,3 bilhões.


Nosso compromisso com a excelência e a qualidade nos torna a escolha ideal tanto para transações sell-side quanto buy-side em M&A. Estamos em busca de profissionais talentosos que desejam fazer parte de nossa equipe, aprender conosco e contribuir para o sucesso dos nossos clientes.


Descrição da Vaga:


Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) entusiasmado(a) e dedicado(a) para se juntar à nossa equipe de M&A. Este estágio oferece uma oportunidade única para aprender com profissionais experientes, adquirir conhecimento prático sobre o mundo de M&A e contribuir para projetos significativos. O candidato ideal será uma pessoa motivada, apaixonada por finanças corporativas e ansiosa para crescer profissionalmente no setor de M&A.


Responsabilidades:


Auxiliar na pesquisa de mercado e análise de setores econômicos.

Apoiar na coleta e análise de dados financeiros e informações relevantes para avaliação de negócios.

Auxiliar na avaliação financeira de empresas de segmentos variados.

Colaborar na criação de apresentações e relatórios para clientes.

Participar de reuniões e contribuir para discussões estratégicas.

Aprender com os membros da equipe sênior e participar ativamente de projetos de M&A.


Requisitos:


Estudante de graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.

Habilidade de análise quantitativa e entendimento de conceitos de finanças corporativas.

Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita.

Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Proficiência em pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

Forte ética de trabalho.


Diferenciais:


Experiência prévia em estágios relacionados a finanças, consultoria ou M&A.

Proatividade, iniciativa e atitude de solucionar problemas.

Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem financeira.

Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e se adaptar a ambientes dinâmicos.

Interesse pela área de Fusões e Aquisições.


Benefícios:


Anywhere office – trabalhe de onde quiser.

Oportunidade de aprendizado e crescimento profissional.

Mentoria por membros da equipe sênior.

Exposição a projetos desafiadores de M&A, em empresas de tamanhos e segmentos variados.

Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador.


Se você é apaixonado por finanças corporativas, deseja desenvolver sua carreira na área de Fusões e Aquisições e atende aos requisitos acima, cadastre-se agora mesmo.


Aguardamos ansiosamente sua inscrição e estamos torcendo para que você seja o novo membro de nossa equipe!

title: Arquiteto de Software e Soluções (C#)
description:
Somos uma consultoria de Engenharia de Software com mais de 15 anos de experiência em qualidade de software e elevado nível técnico quando se trata de automação de testes, segurança digital e cultura DevOps.


_nunca paramos de estudar e aprender , pois estamos sempre em busca de excelência e desenvolvimento.

_valorizamos nosso ambiente colaborativo , pois acreditamos na força do nosso time.

_agimos com transparência e respeito , pois buscamos manter padrões éticos e morais nas nossas relações com colegas, parceiros e clientes.


Nosso time está crescendo. Formamos uma equipe comprometida com resultados e capaz de resolver problemas desafiadores. Venha transformar o mundo da tecnologia conosco!


Como Arquiteto de Software na PrimeUp você irá:


  • Atuar junto ao time da PrimeUp alocado em uma empresa do ramo financeiro;
  • Elaborar soluções corporativas;
  • Definir arquitetura de software da empresa e interagir com times multidisciplinares.


Para assumir esse desafio você precisa de experiência com:


  • .NET (Core) criando APIs de alta performance;
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços e cloud-native;
  • DDD, TDD/BDD, Clean Architecture, SOLID na prática;
  • Mensageria: RabbitMQ, Kafka e Azure Service Bus;
  • Acesso a dados: Entity Framework, Dapper, bancos SQL/NoSQL; cache (REDIS);
  • Observabilidade: Application Insights / OpenTelemetry / ELK (ou equivalente);
  • Cloud (Azure): AKS, App Services, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Application Gateway;
  • Swagger/OpenAPI (contratos, versionamento, políticas);
  • Segurança de APIs: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, controle de acesso e rate limiting;
  • Arquitetura orientada a eventos (CQRS, Event Sourcing) e stream processing (noções e trade-offs);
  • Meios de pagamento e/ou sistemas de missão crítica (SLA/latência/regulatório)

Será bacana se você também tiver conhecimento em:


  • Confluent (Platform/Cloud), schemas (Schema Registry), ksqlDB;
  • Orquestração de processos (Camunda/Zeebe) e Sagas;
  • DevOps/CI/CD e IaC (Terraform, Bicep/ARM, CloudFormation);
  • Experiência com API Gateways (Azure APIM, Sensedia, Kong, etc.) e políticas (throttling, caching, auth, transformations).


Como parte do time da PrimeUp você terá direito a:


  • Contratação CLT com remuneração compatível ao mercado;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Folga Anual Bônus;
  • Reembolso de Certificações;
  • PrimeUp Academy (rede de capacitação profissional);
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Plano de academias;
  • Programa de Bem-Estar com auxílio psicológico, social, financeiro e jurídico.

title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!


Job Description:

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Remote Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our HR team. This professional will be responsible for identifying and assessing the different profiles (Technical and Non-technical). We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handling multiple tasks, and with marked attention to detail. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Review online information of candidates to assess their general fit.

- Contact candidates through phone calls, Skype, LinkedIn, or mail to validate their interest and motivate them to participate in our process.

- Schedule internal interviews, send the invites, and keep the system records updated.

- Interview candidates to assess their qualifications by validating their profile, experience, interests, commitment, and logic and common sense questions.

- Schedule and confirm technical interviews.

- Follow up with the candidates throughout the process.

- Adapt to a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.


Requirements:


- 2+ previous years of work experience. Previous experience in recruiting roles is a plus.

- Good communication skills, especially in listening and persuasion.

- Time management and organization.

- Flexibility and adaptability to constant changes.

- Working experience in online and phone sales techniques (is a plus).

- Knowledge in IT Industry head-hunting (is a plus).

- Advanced English Level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Lead the end-to-end SAP data conversion and loading lifecycle, including technical data preparation, conversion, execution of data loads, defect management, and reporting.

title: Account Manager
description:
Job Title: Account Manager


Company Overview:

We are a fast-growing agency specializing in building high-converting Shopify pages for eCommerce brands. Our mission is to help Shopify brands convert users into loyal customers faster, increasing sales conversions and lowering their ad spend. We are looking for a highly organized and communicative Account Manager to help us manage communication between our clients and our design/development team.


Role Overview:

The Account Manager will serve as the primary contact for our clients, managing their needs and ensuring seamless communication between them and our design/development team. You will be responsible for driving projects forward, maintaining timelines, and keeping all stakeholders informed. Your role is essential to ensuring client satisfaction and successful project delivery. You will also handle minor updates to client websites using low-code tools such as Replo.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, serving as their main point of contact.
  • Communicate client needs and expectations clearly to the design and development teams.
  • Monitor project progress to ensure timely delivery of tasks and updates.
  • Proactively resolve issues, anticipate client needs, and address concerns promptly.
  • Regularly update clients on the status of their projects, keeping them informed and confident.
  • Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth workflow and task prioritization.
  • Use tools like Slack, Clickup, Microsoft Office & Google Sheets to manage communication, track progress, and organize tasks.
  • Occasionally make minor updates to client pages using low-code tools like Replo (training can be provided).
  • Ensure all communication is professional, timely, and aligned with the agency’s standards.



Required Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in account management, client-facing roles, or project coordination (preferred, but flexible).
  • Proficiency in tools like Microsoft Office, Google Docs, Sheets, Slack, and Clickup (preferred).
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with a professional tone.
  • Knowledge of low-code or no-code tools such as Replo, Webflow, or Framer is a plus.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously.
  • High attention to detail and ability to ensure project deadlines are consistently met.



Success in This Role:


The success of this role will be determined by how well you can manage client communication, keep projects on track, and free up the agency owner from direct involvement in day-to-day project management. You will be successful if:

  • Clients feel valued, heard, and confident that their projects are progressing smoothly.
  • Projects are delivered on time without unnecessary delays.
  • You are very proactive and don’t let too much time go by without getting back to clients, and our dev/design team
  • You make sure the check in with clients daily while projects are active, stay on top of the accounts and projects eagerly
  • Projects are delivered on time without unnecessary delays.
  • Communication between clients and the internal team is clear, professional, and well-organized.
  • The agency owner is free to focus on sales and lead generation, thanks to your reliable handling of client accounts.
  • You demonstrate strong organizational skills and professionalism, keeping all stakeholders informed and aligned.


Compensation & Work Schedule:

  • Salary: Pays hourly (depending on experience).
  • Work schedule: Part-time, 25-30 hours per week.
  • Start date: As soon as possible. Preferably someone with minimal need for training, experienced in similar roles.
  • We will start with a 2-3 month trial period to see if we’re a good fit and go from there

title: Program Manager
description:
At Brightdome, we don’t just build digital solutions; we partner with businesses to set the pace of digital greatness. Our mission is to become the world’s most trusted partner in this journey, and we’re looking for an exceptional Program Manager to be at the heart of our client’s success.


The Opportunity


As a Program Manager , you are the conductor of our most critical client engagements. You don’t just manage timelines; you orchestrate complex projects from concept to flawless execution, ensuring we deliver extraordinary value every step of the way. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves being in the center of the action and making things happen.


You will:

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of ambitious, complex digital projects.
  • Serve as the trusted, central point of contact for our clients, building strong partnerships founded on clarity and results.
  • Empower our cross-functional teams by removing roadblocks and fostering a collaborative environment.
  • Proactively anticipate risks and solve problems before they impact the project.
  • Be the engine of execution that keeps everything on time, within scope, and on budget.



Who You Are


We are looking for someone who is driven by a deep sense of ownership and a passion for excellence.

  • You are a master of project management and a natural expeditor; you don’t wait for things to happen, you make them happen.
  • You have an obsessive eye for quality and detail, ensuring nothing short of excellence reaches our clients.
  • You are a phenomenal communicator and a natural organizer. You bring clarity to complexity and build effortless rapport with everyone from engineers to executives.
  • You thrive in a remote, autonomous environment, demonstrating incredible self-discipline and a proactive, entrepreneurial spirit.
  • You have 5+ years of experience successfully delivering complex projects in a client-facing role.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is a strong foundation for this role.



Why Brightdome?


We believe in impact over instruction. At Brightdome, you are a true partner in our mission. We hire talented people and give them the freedom and context to do their best work. We value candor, collaboration, and a relentless drive to find innovative solutions that deliver outsized results for our clients.If this sounds like you, we’d love to talk.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Java Middle Developer
description:
A Exadel está em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java de Nível Intermediário com conhecimento em Quarkus e no protocolo FIX , que contribuirá com tarefas de desenvolvimento enquanto desempenha também um papel de QA técnico. Esse profissional se concentrará em garantir a qualidade do produto, validando integrações, apoiando testes automatizados e colaborando em esforços de desenvolvimento menos complexos em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Apoiar o desenvolvimento de aplicações em Java + Quarku s, entregando funcionalidades e correções de bugs. Auxiliar na implementação e validação de integrações do protocolo FIX . Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração e de ponta a ponta).Garantir a qualidade do código e manter a cobertura de testes em toda a equipe. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto os requisitos técnicos quanto os de negócios. Prestar suporte na resolução de problemas em aplicações de produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com as equipes de negócios e tecnologia.


Habilidades Técnicas Necessárias

Experiência prática com Java 11+ . Conhecimento de Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX . Experiência com JUnit, RestAssured ou outras ferramentas de automação de testes. Compreensão de APIs REST. Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS). Conhecimento básico de Docker e Kubernetes. Experiência com frameworks de QA (Cucumber, Selenium ou Cypress). Exposição à nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

title: Remote .NET Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for .NET Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs for the Degreed product.

- Use SOLID principles in creating maintainable and high quality code.

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes meet business requirements and fulfill the Degreed strategy.

- Work closely with designers, UX, and other developers to gain understanding of new features, dependencies, and technical details.

- Other duties as assigned.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Web projects, C #, SQL Server.

- Experience with HTML / CSS and Javascript frameworks.

- Experience with MVC.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management.

  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: Business Analyst - 45430
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Lead Analyst / Content Team Lead to manage and mentor a team of analysts creating business-focused content to improve AI models. You’ll combine leadership, quality oversight, and subject expertise in MBA-relevant domains to ensure outputs are accurate, logically sound, and aligned with project goals. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys people management, operational excellence, and shaping high-quality analytical content.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts/Content Specialists.
  • Allocate tasks, oversee workflows, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Conduct QA reviews, refine processes, and improve team efficiency.
  • Provide performance feedback, training, and career development.
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, sharing regular project updates.
  • Guide creation of case studies, scenarios, and structured business content (finance, policy, e-commerce, etc.).


What We’re Looking For:

  • 2+ years of team management experience.
  • 3–6 years in business analysis, consulting, content, or domain-focused projects.
  • Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • Bonus: prior work on LLM performance data, case study writing, or academic/research content.
  • Full-time commitment (40 hrs/week); immediate joiners preferred.


Why Join Us:

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Java Fullstack Developer SR
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, with a passion for building scalable and efficient applications. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications that meet the needs of our clients and stakeholders.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Perform code reviews.


Essential Skills

  • Proficiency in Backend Java and Java Spring Boot;
  • Experience with automated testing in Java (e.g. Unit Test, Integration Test, etc.);
  • Solid experience with Python;
  • Solid Front-end development experience, especially with React (or any other SPA)
  • Experience with Typescript;
  • Experience with Microservices Architecture;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services-based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience using AWS services;
  • Good knowledge on relational and non-relational databases, be able to work with Postgres and MongoDB;
  • Practical understanding of Git or similar VCS, CI/CD practices, with a preference for GitHub Actions or Jenkins;
  • Good communication skills in English.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with GraphQL;
  • Experience with agile development;
  • Familiarity with Message Brokers (RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, etc);
  • Utilization of monitoring tools such as Sumo Logic, New Relic, Datadog, or equivalent solutions for troubleshooting and logging;


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: NFL Social Editor
description:
NFL SOCIAL EDITOR


JOB SUMMARY

NFL social media editors are content creators who manage ClutchPoints’ NFL social pages across Facebook, Instagram, X, and Tiktok. These professionals work within the marketing and communications department and closely follow the company's brand voice, image, and guidelines.



GOALS AND DUTIES

  • Manage the conceptualization and creation of content for all of ClutchPoints' NFL social media brands
  • Build monthly engagement/reach across ClutchPoints’ NFL social pages
  • Be a diehard NFL fan
  • Be able to think differently/creatively
  • Acquire timely information from relevant sources
  • Maintain quality control of all posts and campaigns
  • Be organized and be able to manage multiple social pages
  • Willing to learn photoshop (bonus: photoshop experience) to cover breaking news
  • Be able to find relevant and timely NFL information.
  • Be able to come up with creative photo poster/video highlight ideas using the said NFL information.
  • Be able to write creative captions for our social media fans.
  • Must have general knowledge about the NFL.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be able to work at least 40 hours a week max
  • Must be a sports fan with expertise on the NFL and College Football
  • Must be social media savvy
  • Weekend/night availability (especially on gamedays)
  • Must have native/bilingual proficiency in English and can easily spot any written

English errors (spelling/grammar/wording/etc.).

- You must take an English proficiency exam to test your English skill level (score > 90).

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

Você respira redes sociais e é um(a) gamer? Sabe transformar uma jogada insana em conteúdo de impacto? Acha que o feed de uma marca gamer não pode ser genérico e precisa ser tão épico quanto um Pentakill?

Então talvez essa vaga seja sua!

O que esperamos de você:
  • Domínio das redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter e TikTok);
  • Criatividade pra transformar momentos da comunidade e dos embaixadores em posts virais;
  • Conhecimento em edição de imagens (Photoshop, Canva, ou similares);
  • Experiência com jogos (principalmente League of Legends — sim, saber o que é um “gank” conta pontos);
  • Capacidade de interagir com a comunidade com tom leve, afiado e divertido;
  • Organização pra manter o calendário de publicações em dia e construir ideias novas pros nossos conteúdos.


Diferenciais:
  • Saber o que tá rolando no cenário gamer e nos eSports;
  • Ter noção de edição de vídeo (Reels, Shorts, cortes).


O que você vai fazer:
  • Criar e programar postagens;
  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Back End


Empresa: MBRAS


Sobre a MBRAS:


A MBRAS é referência em soluções tecnológicas e inovação, reconhecida por transformar desafios complexos em produtos digitais eficientes e de alto valor agregado. Priorizamos criatividade, excelência técnica e desenvolvimento contínuo, incentivando um ambiente colaborativo e com crescimento real.

Descrição da Vaga: Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs, arquiteturas escaláveis e conhecimentos em infraestrutura cloud. Você integrará uma equipe dinâmica, trabalhando com projetos estratégicos que fazem diferença direta para nossos clientes e mercado.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter APIs RESTful robustas, escaláveis e performáticas.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de backend eficientes e seguras.
  • Integrar sistemas externos e serviços de terceiros.
  • Otimizar consultas de banco de dados e performance de aplicações.
  • Colaborar ativamente com times de produto, front-end e infraestrutura para entregar soluções eficazes.
  • Garantir versionamento eficiente com Git e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Monitorar aplicações em produção e resolver incidentes técnicos.
  • Acompanhar tendências emergentes em backend e cloud computing.


Requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação backend (Python, Go).
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks backend (FastAPI, Gin, Fiber ou similar).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de containerização (Docker) e orquestração.
  • Noções sólidas em versionamento (Git) e integração contínua (CI/CD).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e escrita.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com TypeScript e testes automatizados (Jest, PyTest, JUnit).
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka) e cache distribuído.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência com ORM/ODM (Prisma, Sequelize, SQLAlchemy, Mongoose).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microserviços e event-driven.
  • Experiência com GraphQL e WebSockets.
  • Conhecimento em Rust para projetos de alta performance.
  • Experiência sólida em infraestrutura cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP): deploy, monitoramento e escalabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em DevOps: Kubernetes, Terraform, monitoring e logging.
  • Projetos pessoais ou contribuições open source relevantes.


Benefícios:


  • Ambiente flexível e colaborativo
  • Oportunidades claras de desenvolvimento profissional
  • Programas contínuos de treinamento e capacitação


Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza inovação, qualidade técnica e desenvolvimento constante, venha construir o futuro com a MBRAS!

title: Steward
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers. On top of that, we pride ourselves on being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.


This job opportunity is for a Steward to one of our foreign-flagged Shuttle Tankers with a 42x42 shift and international crew. We are looking for qualified and committed professionals to join our team.


Requirements:

- COP basic safety (TBSI) (VI/1 Tabelas A-VI/1-1 A 1-4)

- Tank low.g. Oil (EBPQ) V/1

- Security duties training (EFNT/EBCP) VI/6

- Food handling

- National Discharge Book (CIR)

- Passport

- Yellow fever vaccine

- 2nd Dose COVID-19 (ConectSUS)

- Advanced English


Benefits:

-Food voucher

-Health plan extended to dependents, free of charge

-Life insurance, free of charge

-Boarding and disembarking assistance

-Double food voucher in December


Note: All logistics are the responsibility of KNOT, regardless of your state of residence.


If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals and offers development opportunities, apply with us.


All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
What You’ll Do

As part of our talent acquisition team, you are charged with finding top talent. You’re responsible for guiding candidates through our recruiting process and partnering with hiring leaders to help build their teams. You are enthusiastic and driven, which allows you to develop meaning relationships. You are systems savvy and passionate about improving our recruiting process.


We are looking for a Recruiter with experience identifying top talent for niche positions across different verticals. The ideal candidate demonstrates their expertise by sharing recruiting best practices, engaging highly skilled talent while setting time to fill expectations based on data. He/she is organized, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is a strong communicator.


Please submit your resume in English. Applications in other languages cannot be considered.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Partner with Hiring Leaders to develop a complete understanding of each opening.
  • Manage the entire recruiting life cycle from candidate generation through direct sourcing, interviewing, salary negotiations, job file maintenance, offer extension and closing candidates.
  • Identify passive candidates using intricate Boolean searches, user groups, professional and social networking, candidate referrals, networking, and our ATS
  • Be passionate about social media and savvy internet research
  • Pipeline candidates and identify what future opportunities they may be a fit for
  • Focus & lead on Diversity identification, sourcing, and attraction
  • Proactively research and generate new/creative sourcing ideas for filling challenging positions by using knowledge of current sourcing practices and trends
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships with candidates and hiring leaders throughout the recruiting lifecycle


What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Approximately 6+ years of proven experience as a technical recruiter, with a strong track record of sourcing and closing talent in engineering and product roles.
  • In-house recruiting experience, ideally within tech/SaaS environments
  • Proven track record managing full-cycle recruitment: kick-off calls, job postings, sourcing, screening, assessments, interview coordination, and offer management
  • Excellent written and spoken English

description:

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. Procuramos SAP SD Consultant - Senior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

  • Fluência em inglês é mandatória para uma comunicação eficaz entre equipes globais e stakeholders.
  • Mais de 7 anos de experiência funcional em SAP com um dos módulos identificados – SD.

  • Habilidade na implementação, customização e manutenção do módulo SAP SD e submódulos relacionados (por exemplo, Contratos, Cotações, Pedidos, Gestão de Clientes, Precificação, Configuração de Variantes).

  • Possui sólido conhecimento de Processos de Negócios, incluindo fluxo e análise de iDoc e EDI.
  • Construi relacionamentos profissionais com os usuários de negócios dos clientes e membros da equipe para garantir a resolução de problemas e a entrega das soluções propostas.

  • Experiência em fornecer soluções independentes para problemas complexos.
  • Desenvolve cotações, pedidos e faturas, bem como execuções de faturamento subsequentes.
  • Integração com MM, FI e FM para integrar funcionalidades.



O que oferecemos?

  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação

Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
Inside Sales Representative

Location: Sao Paulo- Remote

Type: Full-Time


About the Role

Are you a driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment? Do you love building relationships, identifying opportunities, and closing deals? If so, BSI Americas is looking for you!


We're on the lookout for a Bilingual Inside Sales Representative (English & Portuguese) who’s passionate about helping organizations grow through high-quality assurance services and solutions. If you’re motivated, organized, and enjoy collaborating across teams, this could be your next career move.

In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Growth: Propose and close new contracts, meet and exceed revenue goals, and ensure client satisfaction in your territory.
  • Build Relationships: Engage with key decision-makers at small to mid-sized organizations to understand their needs and align our services to support their goals.
  • Prospect Like a Pro: Use a blended approach of outreach—social media, email, cold calling, and more—to grow and manage your sales funnel.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with marketing and field sales to identify new opportunities and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Stay Organized & Informed: Maintain accurate sales data in Salesforce and stay up to date on our full suite of services.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree (BBA preferred).
  • At least 2 years of experience in a consultative inside sales role.
  • 1+ year of experience selling assurance services (a plus!).
  • Proven ability to meet/exceed sales quotas and close deals with confidence.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools like Salesforce, plus the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to adapt and apply a structured sales methodology.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal).


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, health, vision, dental and life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, short-term and long-term disability, pregnancy and parental leave, registered savings plan, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.


Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.


If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Finance Operations Analyst
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in more than 30 countries. As pioneers in the gift card space, we hold two-thirds of the global market share. Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


We are currently seeking a Finance Operations Analyst to join our team in Brazil. This role is ideal for professionals with a strong technical and financial background, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for data-driven operations.


Note: Fluent or advanced English is required for daily communication with international teams.


About the Role

As a Finance Operations Analyst, you will be responsible for driving operational efficiencies related to customer and product pricing information within InComm’s Financial Information Systems. You will apply your understanding of the prepaid business, technical expertise, and strong communication skills to foster collaboration across teams involved in delivering our services globally.

You will work closely with Domestic and International Retail Sales, Product Account Management, and technical teams responsible for pricing, billing, invoicing, settlement, and reconciliation. This role also supports the Analyst II position and contributes to improving pricing and billing processes, ensuring client and channel satisfaction.

You will be expected to study enterprise data stewardship across multiple channels and platforms, review project and business requirements, and communicate effectively across internal and functional groups to ensure timely and accurate project delivery.


Responsibilities

  • Provide concise weekly status reports for assigned activities
  • Promote idea generation and collaboration sessions with internal teams
  • Follow processes and protocols for data enrichment technologies
  • Communicate data requirements to internal counterparts and customers
  • Share process changes with cross-functional teams
  • Escalate data inconsistencies promptly to avoid urgent issues
  • Track and log issues for retrospectives and suggest process improvements
  • Manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, and handle multiple assignments
  • Enforce workflows and business rules to improve data quality and delivery time
  • Enforce SLAs for Finance Data Administration tasks
  • Troubleshoot data-related incidents
  • Research and document rules for secure protocols and data integrity
  • Perform other tasks and responsibilities as assigned


Skills and Attributes

  • Self-directed and proactive
  • Decisive problem solver
  • Ability to influence others
  • Forward-thinking and adaptable
  • Strong business acumen and technical background
  • Effective time management and organizational skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Ability to multitask and work collaboratively


Experience and Education

  • 1+ years of experience in the prepaid product industry, preferably with exposure to Finance, Accounting, or Data Management
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence decisions
  • Ability to work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals and resolve problems
  • Solid technical background with the ability to learn new platforms and apply knowledge to operational practices
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to take initiative
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication skills, including confidence in presenting to executive leadership
  • Ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or related fields preferred
  • CPM or PMP certification is a plus, but not required


Additional Notes

This role involves working with financial data and system configurations, supporting billing migrations, and ensuring accurate invoice generation. Candidates should be inquisitive, data-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks in a dynamic environment.

title: Finance Operations Analyst
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in more than 30 countries. As pioneers in the gift card space, we hold two-thirds of the global market share. Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


We are currently seeking a Finance Operations Analyst to join our team in Brazil. This role is ideal for professionals with a strong technical and financial background, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for data-driven operations.


Note: Fluent or advanced English is required for daily communication with international teams.


About the Role

As a Finance Operations Analyst, you will be responsible for driving operational efficiencies related to customer and product pricing information within InComm’s Financial Information Systems. You will apply your understanding of the prepaid business, technical expertise, and strong communication skills to foster collaboration across teams involved in delivering our services globally.

You will work closely with Domestic and International Retail Sales, Product Account Management, and technical teams responsible for pricing, billing, invoicing, settlement, and reconciliation. This role also supports the Analyst II position and contributes to improving pricing and billing processes, ensuring client and channel satisfaction.

You will be expected to study enterprise data stewardship across multiple channels and platforms, review project and business requirements, and communicate effectively across internal and functional groups to ensure timely and accurate project delivery.


Responsibilities

  • Provide concise weekly status reports for assigned activities
  • Promote idea generation and collaboration sessions with internal teams
  • Follow processes and protocols for data enrichment technologies
  • Communicate data requirements to internal counterparts and customers
  • Share process changes with cross-functional teams
  • Escalate data inconsistencies promptly to avoid urgent issues
  • Track and log issues for retrospectives and suggest process improvements
  • Manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, and handle multiple assignments
  • Enforce workflows and business rules to improve data quality and delivery time
  • Enforce SLAs for Finance Data Administration tasks
  • Troubleshoot data-related incidents
  • Research and document rules for secure protocols and data integrity
  • Perform other tasks and responsibilities as assigned


Skills and Attributes

  • Self-directed and proactive
  • Decisive problem solver
  • Ability to influence others
  • Forward-thinking and adaptable
  • Strong business acumen and technical background
  • Effective time management and organizational skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Ability to multitask and work collaboratively


Experience and Education

  • 1+ years of experience in the prepaid product industry, preferably with exposure to Finance, Accounting, or Data Management
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence decisions
  • Ability to work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals and resolve problems
  • Solid technical background with the ability to learn new platforms and apply knowledge to operational practices
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to take initiative
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication skills, including confidence in presenting to executive leadership
  • Ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or related fields preferred
  • CPM or PMP certification is a plus, but not required


Additional Notes

This role involves working with financial data and system configurations, supporting billing migrations, and ensuring accurate invoice generation. Candidates should be inquisitive, data-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks in a dynamic environment.

description:
Somos a OSBR, uma consultoria de tecnologia que utiliza as melhores e mais atuais tecnologias do mercado para transformar dados em informações estratégicas. Nosso foco é impulsionar a tomada de decisão por meio de indicadores, sempre respeitando o momento e a cultura de cada empresa.


Estamos com uma oportunidade de Desenvolvedor WSO2!


Se você busca desafios e deseja trabalhar com tecnologias modernas em projetos de grande impacto, confira os detalhes abaixo:


Detalhes da posição:

  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Modelo de contratação: PJ
  • Benefícios: 15 dias de descanso após 1 ano + incentivo financeiro para certificações (em reais e em dólar)

  • Desenvolver serviços e APIs no WSO2 Integrator e API Manager.

  • Noções sólidas de protocolos e padrões de integração.

  • Familiaridade com Git, CI/CD e ambientes de containers.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) full stack (.NET e Angular)
description:
Quem somos:

Prezensa, uma empresa de tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.

Nascemos da fusão de três consultorias com mais de 10 anos de trajetória (ESX, DevLand e Squad Premium) para criar um novo modelo no setor: mais humano, mais presente, mais estratégico.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar a primeira PeopleTech do Brasil, unindo excelência técnica com acompanhamento próximo, de ponta a ponta.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.


Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.



Requisitos da vaga

Hard skills:

  • Angular 8+;
  • TypeScript;
  • HTML5, CSS3, SASS;
  • Pixel-perfect e cuidado com responsividade;
  • JavaScript moderno (ES6+);
  • .Net Framework 4.8+;
  • ASP.Net Web API e API Management;
  • Modelo arquitetural REST/SOAP;
  • SOA e/ou Microsserviços;
  • Cloud (Azure);
  • Azure Pipelines;
  • Sistemas distribuídos (Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos);
  • Padrão de projeto MVC;
  • Testes automatizados (TDD);
  • Bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server);
  • Design Patterns e SOLID;
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Lean, Kanban, SAFe);
  • Qualidade de código (boas práticas, clean code);
  • Git;
  • Inglês técnico.



Diferenciais:

  • Ensino Superior em Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Bancos de dados não-relacionais, como Neo4j;
  • React Native;
  • React;
  • Experiência em Acessibilidade;
  • Domain Driven Design (DDD);
  • Experiência com o mercado Segurador, Previdenciário e/ou Financeiro.



Soft skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade;
  • Dinamismo;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.


O que nós oferecemos:

  • Descontos nas Universidades FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta e Full Cycle;
  • Parceria com a Open English e Cellep para aprimoramento do inglês;
  • Oportunidade de realizar cursos e certificações;
  • Apoio para participação em eventos de TI;
  • Acesso a serviços de saúde e bem-estar através da nossa parceria com a Wellhub.

title: Data Analyst (Azure)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or related field.
  • Skilled in quantitative research and statistical modeling for delivering insights.
  • Proficient in complex SQL queries and stored procedures with attention to detail.
  • Experienced in Client Relationship Management and multitasking in fast-paced environments.
  • 4-5 years' hands-on experience in Report Development and Data Analysis.
  • Experience working with Power BI for data visualization and reporting.
  • Familiarity with GitHub and Visual Studios SSIS/SSRS for code management and reporting.
  • Proficient in Python for data manipulation, with knowledge of PowerBI/Qlik.
  • Expertise in entire quantitative research process and statistical methods.
  • Ability to communicate data-driven stories effectively and achieve business outcomes.
  • Understanding of software development best practices and cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication skills in English are required to work effectively with our US-based clients.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Understand business requirements, determine relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and prepare visualization reports.
  • Gathering data from various sources like databases, APIs, files, and streams, and ensuring its integration into a suitable format for analysis.
  • Preparing the data for analysis by addressing inconsistencies, errors, and missing values to ensure its quality and reliability.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver actionable insights.
  • Implementing and maintaining data governance policies and security measures to safeguard sensitive information and ensure compliance with regulations.
  • Employing statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms to analyze data, identify patterns, trends, and insights, and develop predictive models for forecasting.


Qualifications

Tableau, Power BI and Qlik


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.
