Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. We are looking for medically trained professionals to help evaluate and improve large language model (LLM) outputs in the healthcare domain. Your role will focus on ensuring that AI-generated medical content is accurate, safe, and clinically relevant.

  • Nurse Practitioners, Physician Assistants, or international equivalents

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week (with at least 4 hours/day overlap with PST). Options: 20 hrs/week or 30 hrs/week.

title: Musician Job (Earn $20/hr) - 42981
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview

Turing is inviting musicians to participate in a unique research initiative. As part of the Common Lives Project, you and a fellow musician will wear GoPros during your collaborative practice or recording sessions. Your footage will power future AI models that understand complex, real-world activities.


Responsibilities:

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment


Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage


Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips


Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

title: Artist Gig (Record & Earn $20/hr) - 42981
description:
Role Overview

Are you an artist working closely with another creator or assistant in your studio? Turing is looking for artists to wear GoPros and record their daily creative process as part of the Common Lives Project. This data will train AI to understand creativity, hands-on collaboration, and real-world artistic routines.


Responsibilities

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment


Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage


Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips


Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project


Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative


Offer Details

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia


Application Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

title: Atlassian Consultant
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we are committed to transforming teamwork across industries through innovative Atlassian services. Our global team, proficient in DevOps and ITSM, specializes in agile methodologies and AI solutions tailored for Atlassian products. Serving over 1000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we are known for managed licensing, consulting, and AI-driven Atlassian integrations. Our diverse team brings cutting-edge solutions to every project, trusted by leading global firms and reflected in our client success stories.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for an Atlassian Consultant. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Atlassian products such as Jira and Confluence, providing training to clients, and ensuring the smooth integration of Atlassian tools into their workflow. You will also consult on best practices, develop custom solutions to meet client needs, and provide ongoing support and maintenance.

Qualifications
  • Experience with configuring and implementing Atlassian products like Jira, Confluence, and JSM
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps practices and ITSM methodologies
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies and AI solutions for Atlassian tools
  • Skills in providing training and support for Atlassian tools
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Fortune 500 clients or large-scale enterprise projects is a plus

Engenharia de Dados Pleno

Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.). Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados). Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

A Hy Brazil atua há mais de 20 anos no setor de energia, iniciando no segmento de construção civil e, passando atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos, licenciamento, geração, operação, manutenção e comercialização de energia.

Com mais de 70 usinas em operação comercial em seu portfólio, somando mais de 200 MW instalados, trabalhamos de forma verticalizada desde o licenciamento até a operação em projetos hidrelétricos, solares e eólicos.

Realizamos a gestão de mais de 10.000 unidades consumidoras em geração distribuída, concentradas em 9 distribuidoras nos estados de MG, SP, RJ, GO, MT, BA, TO, PE e CE.


Sobre a vaga


O que você fará


  • Operar as usinas hidrelétricas e solares de forma remota.
  • Realizar contatos com concessionárias de energia, provedores de internet e com operadores locais das usinas.
  • Elaboração de boletins de geração.
  • Monitorar Links de internet, manobras na rede da concessionaria e níveis de reservatório.
  • Realizar análise de causas de falhas e tratativas junto com operadores de campo ou concessionária de energia.

O que é necessário

  • Disponibilidade de trabalho em escala.
  • Ensino Médio Completo.


Desejável

  • Curso Técnico em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica, Eletromecânica
  • Pacote Office Básico


O que oferecemos

  • Plano saúde nacional
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale Alimentação ou Refeição
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio mobilidade

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos uma pessoa engenheira de dados sênior para atuar na construção e evolução da plataforma de Feature Store, solução interna que acelera o desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning e inteligência artificial.

O foco será no desenvolvimento de pipelines performáticos, frameworks reutilizáveis e mecanismos de qualidade de dados, com forte colaboração com os times de Data Science e MLOps para:

- Desenvolver pipelines escaláveis e de alta performance.

- Projetar soluções com foco em modularização, versionamento e reuso.

- Criar e manter frameworks internos para automação de processos.

- Implementar mecanismos de validação e monitoramento de dados.

- Apoiar a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados.


Requisitos e qualificações

- Experiência sólida com Spark (PySpark) e processamento distribuído.

- Domínio de AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, Redshift).

- Prática com Terraform e conceitos de infraestrutura como código.

- Conhecimento em CI/CD com uso de Git e Jenkins.

- Vivência com frameworks de Data Quality ou validações customizadas.

- Conhecimento em engenharia de software (boas práticas, testes, modularização).


Diferenciais

- Experiência com automação de pipelines de dados e projetos de MLOps/Feature Store.

- Experiência com projetos de IA generativa, especialmente com RAG.



A experiência de trabalhar na Invillia é única. E global. Temos o nosso próprio jeito de conectar talentos e construir inovações.

Revolucionamos o ambiente de trabalho #Instation + somos experts em desenvolver soluções complexas para #GameChangers + temos uma metodologia única #EngagedbyDataPeopleAction + investimos em pessoas #InvilliaAcademy

Alguns diferenciais Invillia:

_inovamos lado-a-lado com #GameChangersGlobais

_cultura de trabalho distribuído #inStation

_metodologia exclusiva #GlobalGrowthFramework

Faça uma imersão aqui


Então, se você busca uma oportunidade de trabalhar de onde estiver, em uma empresa dedicada em recriar a sensação de proximidade, de conexão humana, e de se sentir acolhido a qualquer momento, mesmo com todos distribuídos, aqui é o lugar certo.

title: Contador(a) Especialista em Cálculos Judiciais
description:
Vaga para Contador(a) Especialista em Cálculos Judiciais – 100% Remoto


Você é contador(a) com experiência em cálculos judiciais e gosta de unir precisão técnica à atuação estratégica do processo? Tem facilidade para elaborar projeções com base em diferentes premissas jurídicas, auxiliar tecnicamente os advogados na construção das melhores alternativas e analisar casos com agilidade e responsabilidade?

Se a resposta é “sim”, temos um espaço para você no time da Facilita Jurídico !


Você encontrará aqui:

  • Atuação 100% remota , de qualquer lugar do Brasil;
  • Demandas envolvendo as principais áreas do Direito, com foco em trabalhista , previdenciário e cível ;
  • Plataforma totalmente digital, prática e intuitiva;
  • Suporte técnico especializado para faciliters calculistas, disponível de segunda a sexta, das 8h às 19h, e aos sábados e feriados, das 11h às 17h.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência em cálculos judiciais ;
  • Domínio obrigatório do PJe-Calc para atuação em demandas trabalhistas;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e foco em resultados;
  • Capacidade de atuar com alta demanda e sob pressão ;
  • Disponibilidade full time ;
  • Perfil autodidata e postura proativa ;
  • Habilidade para elaborar feedbacks técnicos claros e objetivos ;
  • Capacidade de apresentar cálculos de forma clara e compreensível para advogados e clientes;
  • Domínio de cálculos revisionais, atualizações monetárias, encargos legais e apurações decorrentes de condenações .


Como participar

Para se habilitar, basta realizar nosso teste de credenciamento . Após a aprovação, você terá acesso à nossa plataforma digital e poderá começar a receber solicitações de cálculo.

title: Brazilian-Portuguese interpreter
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Translate the company's products and business-related documents from English to Portuguese (Brazil) or from Chinese to Portuguese (Brazil) with precision and accuracy in a timely and efficient manner (monthly workload: about 130,000 source English words).
  • Update and maintain the Portuguese (Brazil) termbase of products.
  • Responsible for product localization to improve user experience.
  • Responsible for other translation, localization, and relevant work as assigned.

Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, MockK ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Executivo de Vendas – Cidadania Portuguesa | Eu Na Europa Cidadania


Se você é um vendedor sênior com paixão por transformar vidas através da cidadania europeia, essa vaga é para você!


Estamos expandindo e buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas Sênior para atuar com cidadania portuguesa , dentro de uma das três maiores empresas do setor: Eu Na Europa Cidadania .

Somos referência em processos de cidadania italiana e agora estamos levando nosso know-how também para a cidadania portuguesa . Responsabilidades

  • Atendimento a leads e clientes por telefone, WhatsApp e videoconferência.

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Dados | Remoto
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Newco Gringo + Zapay

Local de trabalho: São Paulo

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto



Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Ser referência técnica para o time de Engenharia de Dados, promovendo o densenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Liderar esforços para padronização de pipelines e criação de bibliotecas próprias;
  • Ser referência em dados, interagindo com as áreas que são data sources para alinhar conceitos, integridade e governança;
  • Atuar na gestão de custos dos recursos utilizados para coleta, armazenamento, processamento e compartilhamento de dados;
  • Trabalhar na migração de ambientes legados para novas infraestruturas;
  • Garantir qualidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e manutenabilidade das plataformas de dados.


É imprescindível que você tenha:

  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender;
  • Orientação para resultados de negócio e capacidade de definir e executar prioridades de forma estratégica;
  • Experiência com diferentes técnicas de arquitetura e modelagem de dados (Ex.: Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Mart, etc);
  • Experiência em sistemas de dados distribuídos e processamento paralelo (Spark, Databricks, etc);
  • Experiência em implementação, manutenção e orquestração de pipelines de dados, principalmente com Airflow;
  • Conhecimentos sobre computação em nuvem e soluções de infraestrutura de dados (AWS e/ou GCP);
  • Familiaridade com Terraform;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST;
  • Conhecimentos de segurança e governança de dados

title: Manager Endpoint Engineers
description:
Position Overview


We are seeking a Manager of Endpoint Engineers to lead our endpoint management team in maintaining and securing 600+ corporate devices across our global organization. This remote position requires a leader with a relentless focus on automation, efficiency, and reducing contact time while ensuring compliance across multiple security frameworks. You will manage a team of 4 engineers and report directly to the VP of IT and DevOps.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead and mentor a team of 4 endpoint engineers, providing technical guidance and career development
  • Oversee maintenance, patching, and compliance for 600+ Windows and macOS endpoints using NinjaOne
  • Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual processes and minimize end-user contact time
  • Ensure endpoints meet compliance requirements
  • Develop and implement endpoint security policies and procedures
  • Manage vendor relationships with endpoint management and security solution providers
  • Respond to and troubleshoot complex endpoint issues, maintaining hands-on technical involvement
  • Create and maintain documentation for endpoint standards and processes
  • Collaborate with security and IT teams to implement endpoint protection strategies
  • Monitor endpoint health metrics and implement improvements to enhance reliability
  • Coordinate patch management cycles and ensure timely deployment across all devices
  • Lead incident response efforts for endpoint-related security events


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • 2+ years of people management experience in IT or technical teams
  • 5+ years of hands-on endpoint management experience
  • Strong proficiency with NinjaOne or similar endpoint management platforms
  • Experience managing both Windows and macOS environments at scale
  • Demonstrated experience automating endpoint management tasks using PowerShell, Python, or similar
  • Deep understanding of patch management, software deployment, and configuration management
  • Experience maintaining compliance with security frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, CCPA)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with ability to resolve complex technical issues
  • Excellent communication skills for vendor management and cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Must be able to read and speak fluently in English


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in cybersecurity or identity governance industries
  • Certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator or similar
  • Experience with zero-trust security models and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
  • Experience with automation tools and scripting for large-scale deployments
  • Background in implementing self-service IT solutions


Work Environment


  • This is a fully remote position
  • Must be available for occasional meetings across global time zones
  • On-call rotation participation may be required for critical issue

This remote position requires a leader with a relentless focus on automation, efficiency, and reducing contact time while ensuring compliance across multiple security frameworks. You will manage a team of 4 engineers and report directly to the VP of IT and DevOps.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead and mentor a team of 4 endpoint engineers, providing technical guidance and career development
  • Oversee maintenance, patching, and compliance for 600+ Windows and macOS endpoints using NinjaOne
  • Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual processes and minimize end-user contact time
  • Ensure endpoints meet compliance requirements
  • Develop and implement endpoint security policies and procedures
  • Manage vendor relationships with endpoint management and security solution providers
  • Respond to and troubleshoot complex endpoint issues, maintaining hands-on technical involvement
  • Create and maintain documentation for endpoint standards and processes
  • Collaborate with security and IT teams to implement endpoint protection strategies
  • Monitor endpoint health metrics and implement improvements to enhance reliability
  • Coordinate patch management cycles and ensure timely deployment across all devices
  • Lead incident response efforts for endpoint-related security events


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • 2+ years of people management experience in IT or technical teams
  • 5+ years of hands-on endpoint management experience
  • Strong proficiency with NinjaOne or similar endpoint management platforms
  • Experience managing both Windows and macOS environments at scale
  • Demonstrated experience automating endpoint management tasks using PowerShell, Python, or similar
  • Deep understanding of patch management, software deployment, and configuration management
  • Experience maintaining compliance with security frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, CCPA)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with ability to resolve complex technical issues
  • Excellent communication skills for vendor management and cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Must be able to read and speak fluently in English


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in cybersecurity or identity governance industries
  • Certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator or similar
  • Experience with zero-trust security models and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
  • Experience with automation tools and scripting for large-scale deployments
  • Background in implementing self-service IT solutions


Work Environment


  • This is a fully remote position
  • Must be available for occasional meetings across global time zones
  • On-call rotation participation may be required for critical issue

title: Data Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.


  • Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.


  • Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing a solution for a big retail company. The main focus is to support processing of big data volumes and integrate solution to current architecture.


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong, recent hands-on expertise with Azure Data Factory and Synapse is a must (3+ years).

• Experience in leading a distributed team.

• Strong expertise in designing and implementing data models, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, to support efficient data storage and retrieval.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, pySpark for building scalable and reliable data solutions.

• Extensive experience with building robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data lakes or data warehouses.

• Ability to integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, using appropriate techniques such as API integration or message queuing.

• Proficiency in designing and implementing data warehousing solutions (dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Mesh, Data/Delta Lakehouse, Data Vault)

• Proficiency in SQL to perform complex queries, data transformations, and performance tuning on cloud-based data storages.

• Experience integrating metadata and governance processes into cloud-based data platforms

• Certification in Azure, Databricks, or other relevant technologies is an added advantage

• Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.

• Experience with Azure MI, Azure Database for Postgres, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Analysis Services, and Informix.

• Experience with Python and Python-based ETL tools.

• Experience with shell scripting in Bash, Unix or windows shell is preferable.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Experience with Elasticsearch

• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Troubleshooting and Performance Tuning: Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in data processing workflows and optimize data pipelines for efficient data ingestion and analysis.

• Collaboration and Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with stakeholders, data engineers, data scientists, and other cross-functional teams.


Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Full Stack Software Developer (JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, MySQL)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Full Stack Software Developer with 3+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven experience in on-time delivery, strong problem-solving abilities, and an aptitude for quickly learning new technologies and concepts. They will also be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.


The client provides end-to-end outsourced yard and transportation management solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors.

Yard management is the process of organizing, planning, and controlling the movement of vehicles, containers, and other assets within a warehouse, distribution center, or manufacturing facility. Yard management tasks include: Scheduling and conducting loading and unloading operations, tracking the location of assets, organizing the movement of trucks, managing gate access, and sequencing loads. Yard management systems (YMS) are software applications that can help automate and optimize yard management processes. YMS can provide real-time visibility, gate management, and integration with warehouse management systems.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain legacy PHP/MySQL application
  • Design and develop robust, high-quality, front- and back-end product features with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Develop integrations using external and internal APIs
  • Apply good development practices following team standards and look for opportunities to improve and innovate
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Collaborate with leadership, product management, and other key stakeholders on building a product that wins market share
  • Deliver high-quality code with velocity and provide work estimates based on task complexity


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Minimum 3 years of Full-Stack software development experience using JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, and MySQL
  • Experience building production, commercial-quality applications, using Agile and other modern development methodologies and best practices
  • Background building and consuming REST services
  • Solid understanding of modern programming fundamentals
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities, as well as an aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to ensure deadlines are met with high quality
  • Team player with practical communication skills and collaborative approach


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Familiar with the use of containers and container orchestration, such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Familiar with Yard Management or Logistics Services industry
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Clinical Medicine
description:
We are currently looking for researchers, retired researchers, and former researchers who can perform peer reviews for journals and publishers.

Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work . Please read the recruitment requirements carefully and fill out the application form accurately. Thank you.

WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 3 paper in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past two years
  • Published at least 12 papers in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past ten years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills , with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty : Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology : Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review : Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions : Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback : Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication : Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Carpenter Role (Earn $20/hr) - 42981
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview

Turing is recruiting carpenters for the Common Lives Project, a research program using wearable GoPro footage to improve AI understanding of manual labor. Record your woodworking, building, or fabrication routines as part of this short-term paid project.

title: VIP RELATIONSHIP MANAGER
description:
ABOUT

We are looking for an enthusiastic RM to join our Client Service function and serve as the primary point of contact, to further enhance customer experience, foster client loyalty, and drive business success in the region (Brazil).


Responsibilities:


  • Perform client acquisition and strong relationship management with a portfolio of global VIP clients in Brazil and LATAM;


  • Build rapport, including enhancing and expanding relationships with existing clients via frequent and sustained communication;


  • Develop key customer service processes and systems, establish management rules, and track the status of key customers;


  • Analyze client behavior, identify their unspoken needs, and prepare key customer analysis reports;


  • Liaise with various stakeholders from different departments to provide optimal service solutions and customer experience.


Qualifications:

  • At least 4–7 years of experience in sales and client services with an international financial background in banking, investments, etc.;


  • Client portfolio including institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals, private banking customers, brokers, futures institutions, or commercial banks;


  • Experience working in trading platforms or exchanges is highly advantageous;


  • Strong communication and writing skills;


  • Proficient in Portuguese (written and spoken), with working knowledge of English; Spanish would be a plus;


  • Able to work under pressure and tight deadlines while maintaining strong multi-tasking skills.

title: DevOps Database Engineer (MS SQL / AWS)
description:
Your role and responsibilities:


  • Design and develop Database-as-a-Service solutions for MS SQL using .NET, PowerShell, Python , and other automation tools.
  • Leverage cutting-edge AWS Cloud technologies to build and innovate database infrastructure.
  • Perform performance analysis and tuning for MS SQL environments.
  • Automate and streamline database management processes.
  • Conduct POC analysis and document complex, business-critical database workflows.
  • Lead incident analysis and provide corrective action recommendations.
  • Develop and implement database alerting and monitoring solutions.
  • Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as part of our database product offerings.
  • Own the full DevOps lifecycle: design, code, test, deploy, and monitor .


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Deep of experience in database engineering and automation.
  • Strong experience with AWS and services like CFN, SSM , and container technologies.
  • Deep expertise in MS SQL administration , including HA, backup/restore, security, and performance tuning.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for Windows environments.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-level production databases .
  • Familiarity with DevOps frameworks and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
The Application Support Engineer will provide technical and functional support for a portfolio of business-critical applications, including maintenance, quality, EHS, production monitoring, IoT integration, and access control systems. The role requires troubleshooting, user support, system monitoring, and collaboration with vendors and internal teams to ensure optimal application performance and compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Level 2/3 support for applications such as LIMS - LABWARE , EHS-INTELEX, DIMEP, MATICS, ST-One, and THINGWORX.
  • Troubleshoot incidents, service requests, and change requests, ensuring timely resolution and minimal business disruption.
  • Monitor application health, performance, and integrations.
  • Support end users across multiple countries and languages, ensuring high-quality service and clear communication.
  • Maintain documentation, audit trails, and compliance with regulatory and security standards.
  • Participate in system upgrades, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Support integration and data flow between applications and enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Azure, Snowflake).
  • Ensure applications meet business needs in areas such as maintenance, quality management, EHS, production monitoring, and access control.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Experience supporting enterprise applications in manufacturing, quality, EHS, or IoT environments.
  • Knowledge of Spanish and Portuguese language required.
  • Familiarity with LIMS, SAP, EHS/ESG platforms, IoT data collection, and access control systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Experience with SQL, Windows, Azure, and integration platforms.
  • Ability to work with global teams and support users in multiple regions.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Strong experience in manufacturing apps.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud-based solutions and real-time production monitoring.
  • Knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.
  • Multilingual support capabilities (English, Spanish and Portuguese).

title: Account Executive
description:
Near is a startup focused on bridging the gap between remote Latin American talent and companies hiring in the US and abroad. Our team spans 20+ members across four different countries. We've landed numerous great customers and have helped hundreds of people from LatAm improve their lives and wallets with jobs at US companies.


We're looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive who is autonomous, creative, and enterprising to join our team. This is a financially rewarding opportunity with a highly competitive compensation structure – uncapped commission. If you can source and qualify leads effectively, you'll make a lot of money.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve sales targets
  • Expand revenue originated from existing accounts
  • Create new opportunities through outbound prospecting.
  • Close inbound leads
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Leverage our existing network to get referrals
  • Understand industry-specific landscapes and trends.
  • Become an expert in the staffing industry.


Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Native-like English level
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and effectively manage time.
  • A proactive mindset: always pursuing your next goal.
  • Motivated by commission and career growth.
  • Track record of exceeding quota as SDR.


Traits that Would Make You a Strong Fit:

  • Proactive.
  • Optimistic and positive.
  • Intense, driving, and impatient (with regard to results and getting work done).
  • Pay attention to detail when necessary.
  • High EQ – can read the room and connect with people
  • Responds empathetic to others.
  • Follow-through skills.
  • Accountability


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Uncapped commission – the more you close, the higher your commission will be.
  • Results-focused role and team. No BS. No unnecessary processes and bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to grow and work on larger and more complex deals.
  • A team with a great culture.
  • Join a team of high-performers.


Interview Process:

  • Assessment
  • Video Interview
  • Interview with COO
  • Final interview

title: Cross-Platform Mobile Engineer
description:
At Intellias , we're always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our team in Colombia. Over 20 years of market experience, Intellias brings together technologists, creators and innovators in Europe, North and Latin America, and the Middle East. Join our international team and take the mission to solve the advanced tech challenges of tomorrow!


If you're enthusiastic about contributing your skills and experience to our organization, we invite you to submit your CV for this position.


We can offer you:

B2b Contract

USD salary

100% remote work


Requirements:

  • 7+ years of working experience in software engineering
  • Advanced experience with Kotlin (Android), C, C++
  • Extensive experience developing iOS mobile native applications in Swift/SwiftUI
  • Knowledge and experience with SwiftUI and Combine
  • Solid understanding of the full iOS mobile development life cycle
  • Strong knowledge of iOS UI design principles and best practices
  • Experience with at least one of these design architectures: MVVM, MVC, VIPER, Clean (Onion Architecture)
  • Eperience with TCA or other Redux-like architectures
  • Expert in UI layouts and creating adaptive layouts for various hardware configurations
  • Experience writing custom views and controls
  • Experience consuming RESTful JSON/XML web services
  • Experience in testing high volume applications: unit test, integration test, performance test
  • Experience using external commercial and open source libraries
  • Experience with Git and GitFlow
  • A solid grasp of fundamental algorithms, data structures, and design patterns
  • Portfolio of apps that you’ve built; ideally available in the App Store
  • Ability to prototype new features and redesign existing ones
  • Excellent problem solving, debugging skills, critical thinking, and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
  • Aptitude and desire to independently learn new technologies
  • Advanced level of English, good communication skills.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in Core Animation, Core Graphics, Core Bluetooth (Classic, BLE)
  • Experience in automated user interface functional testing
  • Experience with Scrum/Agile methodologies
  • Experience mentoring junior members
  • Experience with iOS performance profiling tools and optimization techniques
  • Experience with Open API standard (Swagger)
  • Experience with push notifications
  • Working knowledge of Internationalization
  • Proficient in Objective-C
  • Experience with UIKit

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Você será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações robustas, escaláveis e seguras em Python , assegurando alta performance e qualidade. Atuará com frameworks modernos como FastAPI ou Django , construindo soluções que gerem impacto real para os usuários, além de utilizar ORMs (Django ORM ou SQLAlchemy) para otimizar a interação com bancos de dados relacionais. Participará de todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software , desde a concepção da ideia, definição da arquitetura e implementação de funcionalidades, até a implantação e manutenção contínua. Também contribuirá para a melhoria contínua dos processos , trazendo novas ideias e boas práticas que agreguem valor ao time e aos projetos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Python .
  • Vivência prática com frameworks como FastAPI ou Django , sabendo quando e como utilizá-los da melhor forma.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e ORMs (Django ORM ou SQLAlchemy) , com entendimento de modelagem de dados e boas práticas de performance.
  • Experiência com processos de CI/CD , incluindo versionamento, automação de testes e deploy.
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com vontade de aprender e crescer junto com o time.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

title: IDP Consultant
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We are looking for an IDP Consultant to join our team and deliver end-to-end IDP solutions. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to analyze document requirements, design extraction strategies, configure IDP platforms, and orchestrate document workflows, including human-in-the-loop validation.


What You’ll Do

· Analyze documents and business requirements to define extraction feasibility and development effort.

· Design and architect IDP solutions, including document classification, labeling strategies, extraction rules, NLP/ML models, and workflow design.

· Build and manage workflows including validation and human-in-the-loop activities.

· Conduct testing, performance evaluation, and quality assurance of extraction models.

· Fine-tune classifiers, rules, and ML models to improve accuracy and meet KPIs.

· Collaborate with stakeholders and deliver documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.


What We’re Looking For

· Hands-on experience delivering IDP projects end-to-end.

· Strong knowledge of document extraction techniques, like extraction rules, NLP, deep learning etc.

· Experience with IDP solutions design, architecture, and workflow definition.

· Familiarity with IDP tools such as UiPath Document Understanding, Kofax/ Tungsten, Amazon Textract, Google Document AI, Microsoft AI Builder / Document Intelligence.

· Experience with ABBYY Vantage/FlexiCapture is highly desirable.

· Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g. JavaScript, Python) for customization and integration.

· Strong communication skills with proficiency in English (written and spoken).

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
Join a category-defining AI company building the future of SMB Growth.


At Atlas, we’re making AI-driven phone and voice interactions feel as natural and responsive as talking to a human. Our mission is to help small and mid-sized businesses scale with “AI Revenue Agents” that launch campaigns in minutes and qualify every lead in 60 seconds.

Founded in 2024 by serial entrepreneurs with successful exits, we’re a tight-knit team of 12 A-players who love solving hard problems and moving fast. If you’re excited about building systems that power real-world AI interactions at scale, we want to talk.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer (mid-level) to join our growing engineering team. You’ll help design and build the infrastructure that powers our AI agents, voice pipelines, and integrations with external APIs and customer CRMs. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup, enjoys end-to-end ownership, and wants their work to directly impact customer growth.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services that support Atlas’ AI voice and ad agents.
  • Work with cloud-native tools (serverless functions, queues, storage, etc.) to ensure scalable, reliable systems.
  • Develop and manage APIs that integrate Atlas with third-party CRMs, ad platforms, and communication tools.
  • Ensure data security, authentication, and compliance across all systems.
  • Collaborate with product, AI, and frontend teams to deliver features quickly and iteratively.
  • Monitor and optimize system performance for speed, reliability, and cost efficiency.


Experience

  • 4–7 years in backend development (Node.js, C#, or Python preferred).
  • Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure preferred).
  • Database experience (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Comfortable working with queues, messaging systems, and distributed architectures.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a bias toward action in dynamic environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with API gateways or API management (APIM).
  • Familiarity with authentication providers (Auth0).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and monitoring tools.
  • Background in high-availability systems, call flows, or real-time communications.
  • Agile startup experience where you’ve shipped quickly and iterated fast.


Why Atlas

  • Be part of a small, elite team where your code directly impacts thousands of businesses.
  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems bridging digital ads, real-time voice, and CRM workflows.
  • Fast-moving environment where your contributions are visible and valued.
  • Culture of ownership, honesty, and customer obsession.

Avalara is an AI-first company. We expect every engineer, manager, and leader to actively leverage AI to enhance productivity, quality, innovation, and customer value. AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products — and success at Avalara requires embracing AI as an essential capability, not an optional tool. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to lead in the updating of solutions used by some of our largest customers including national governments.


You will report directly to the senior manager of the department and you will bring expertise in architectural principles, system design best practices, driving the creation of platforms that address complex challenges and empower global organizations. You will demand a blend of technical leadership and hands-on execution.


  • This is a fully remote position; however, only candidates residing in Brazil will be accepted.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be


  • Contribute to hands-on software development: Participate in daily coding tasks, collaborating with teams to solve complex technical challenges, design scalable solutions, and contribute directly to the delivery of high-quality software;

title: Statistics Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Subject Matter Expert (SME) with deep expertise in Statistics to contribute to the design, review, and validation of high-quality academic and training content.


Job Title: Statistics Specialist

Location: Brazil

Language: Portuguese

Required Education: Statistics

Education Qualification: Masters or PhD (No Bachelor's)

Mandatory: LLM Evaluation assessment

LLM Evaluation assessment Link:

Urgently Required: Complete LLM Evaluation assessment by Today itself as project will start from 12th September.


The SME will ensure accuracy, relevance, and alignment with learning objectives while bringing practical insights from their domain knowledge.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, review, and validate Statistics-related content, assessments, and training material.
  • Ensure accuracy, clarity, and adherence to academic and industry standards.
  • Support in creating real-world problem statements, case studies, and project ideas.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for quality delivery.


Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (Master’s/PhD preferred) in a Statistics discipline.
  • Proven expertise in subject area with research/teaching/industry experience.
  • Strong communication and technical writing skills.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Recruitment and Selection Analyst


As a Recruitment and Selection Analyst, you will be responsible for discussing, preparing, and extending the internal offer process, providing guidance to the hiring team on compensation and offer compliance, and navigating differences in offer content from one profession to another and from one country to another.


Basic qualifications include:

  • Higher education degree or currently enrolled
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in recruitment support, administration, and/or customer service


Preferred qualifications include:

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Experience with Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
  • Solid experience and confidence with Microsoft Office (especially Excel, Outlook, Teams)
  • Ability to work in a remote team environment
  • Detail-oriented with a track record of follow-through


Job responsibilities include:

  • Act as a point of contact for the complex offer process
  • Consult with the Hiring Manager, HR, and Compensation teams on hiring decisions, compensation, and offer strategies
  • Calculate, prepare, and present offers to candidates in the Americas and internationally
  • Utilize, maintain, and record candidate recruitment activity in the ATS in accordance with legal and corporate regulations and standards
  • Provide excellent candidate and client experience
  • Respond within service level agreements to a high volume of requests in a fast-paced environment


Required skills:

  • Superior communication and organizational skills
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Ability to break down and explain complex topics
  • Focus on compliance and data accuracy
  • Strong fluency with Microsoft Office
  • Confidence and resourcefulness
  • Responsiveness and follow-through
  • Ability to prioritize in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Quickly adapt to changes with process updates


Applications Accepted on Ongoing Basis Until Filled


The compensation for this position is paid in Brazilian Reais .

title: Engenheiros de Dados
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de Dados experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Liderar a implantação de Data Lakes e Lakehouses, atuando tanto no desenho da arquitetura quanto no desenvolvimento hands-on da solução.

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis para garantir a fluidez entre sistemas.

• Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados em todas as etapas do pipeline.

• Otimizar processos de armazenamento e recuperação de dados, garantindo desempenho e custo eficientes (FINOPS).

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de negócio e tecnologia para transformar requisitos em soluções robustas de dados.

• Implementar e monitorar processos ETL/ELT e arquiteturas de processamento de dados em tempo real e batch.

• Apoiar a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de dados dentro do time.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados escaláveis (preferencialmente em Oracle Cloud).

• Proficiência em SQL, Python e ferramentas de processamento de dados distribuídos (como Spark).

• Conhecimento avançado em Infrastructure as Code e práticas de CI/CD.

• Experiência com modelagem de dados e arquitetura de Data Lakes e Lakehouses.

• Forte entendimento de práticas de governança e qualidade de dados.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês fluente

title: Baker Role (Earn $20/hr) - 42981
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview

Turing is seeking baking professionals to join the Common Lives Project—a research initiative to collect real-world footage that trains AI systems. You and a colleague from the same bakery or workspace will wear GoPro cameras while baking and managing prep throughout the day.


Responsibilities:

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment


Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage


Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips


Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

title: Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Pharmacovigilance Business Analyst (PharmaCov BA)

Duration : 6 to 12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion after 6 months.

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Job Title: Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst / Business Analyst

Location: Brazil

The Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst (PV Product Analyst / BA) will act as a strategic liaison between business users, regulatory teams, and IT, ensuring pharmacovigilance (PV) systems and workflows enable accurate, compliant, and efficient adverse event reporting. This role combines strong product ownership responsibilities with deep domain expertise in pharmacovigilance, regulatory compliance, and technology. The analyst will oversee end-to-end product roadmaps, ensure alignment with business needs, and drive platform upgrades, integrations, and compliance.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Product Ownership & Roadmap
  • Own and manage the PV product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities.
  • Oversee platform maintenance, rebuilding, and tech stack upgrades (e.g., CloudX → KCloud migration).
  • Stay updated on latest pharmacovigilance and product technology trends (AWS, GenAI, SaaS solutions).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Business, Infrastructure, and Leadership teams to plan/manage product releases, downtime, incidents, and upgrades.
  • Serve as the key liaison across regulatory, clinical operations, QA, and IT functions.
  • System Integration & Compliance
  • Oversee safety system integrations (Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety) ensuring accurate data flow and reporting.
  • Ensure Argus acts as the central system, receiving case data from call centers, flowing through safety systems, and reaching regulatory authorities with compliance documentation.
  • Support signal detection and reporting in line with global compliance and regulatory standards (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, GXP, CFR).
  • Monitoring, Debugging & Quality
  • Perform monitoring and debugging for system issues such as unprocessed cases, reconciliation gaps, and data discrepancies.
  • Review AWS logs and system access for issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with QA for system quality checks, validation, and signal monitoring.
  • Analysis & Documentation
  • Gather and analyze requirements for PV systems and workflows.
  • Document processes, data flows, and system functionalities related to adverse event reporting.
  • Support validation and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Provide user training, support, and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Strong experience as a Product Analyst or Business Analyst in a regulated environment.
  • Proven knowledge of pharmacovigilance processes and regulatory requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with PV safety systems such as Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Required Skills:

  • Familiarity with AWS (for RCA/ debugging), Cloud/SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with JIRA for incident/release management.
  • Experience with validation and UAT in regulated environments.

Tools & Technologies:

  • PV systems: Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety.

title: Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Pharmacovigilance Business Analyst (PharmaCov BA)

Duration : 6 to 12 months with possible extension or FTE conversion after 6 months.

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Job Title: Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst / Business Analyst

Location: Brazil

The Pharmacovigilance Product Analyst (PV Product Analyst / BA) will act as a strategic liaison between business users, regulatory teams, and IT, ensuring pharmacovigilance (PV) systems and workflows enable accurate, compliant, and efficient adverse event reporting. This role combines strong product ownership responsibilities with deep domain expertise in pharmacovigilance, regulatory compliance, and technology. The analyst will oversee end-to-end product roadmaps, ensure alignment with business needs, and drive platform upgrades, integrations, and compliance.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Product Ownership & Roadmap
  • Own and manage the PV product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities.
  • Oversee platform maintenance, rebuilding, and tech stack upgrades (e.g., CloudX → KCloud migration).
  • Stay updated on latest pharmacovigilance and product technology trends (AWS, GenAI, SaaS solutions).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Business, Infrastructure, and Leadership teams to plan/manage product releases, downtime, incidents, and upgrades.
  • Serve as the key liaison across regulatory, clinical operations, QA, and IT functions.
  • System Integration & Compliance
  • Oversee safety system integrations (Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety) ensuring accurate data flow and reporting.
  • Ensure Argus acts as the central system, receiving case data from call centers, flowing through safety systems, and reaching regulatory authorities with compliance documentation.
  • Support signal detection and reporting in line with global compliance and regulatory standards (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, GXP, CFR).
  • Monitoring, Debugging & Quality
  • Perform monitoring and debugging for system issues such as unprocessed cases, reconciliation gaps, and data discrepancies.
  • Review AWS logs and system access for issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with QA for system quality checks, validation, and signal monitoring.
  • Analysis & Documentation
  • Gather and analyze requirements for PV systems and workflows.
  • Document processes, data flows, and system functionalities related to adverse event reporting.
  • Support validation and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Provide user training, support, and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Strong experience as a Product Analyst or Business Analyst in a regulated environment.
  • Proven knowledge of pharmacovigilance processes and regulatory requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with PV safety systems such as Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Required Skills:

  • Familiarity with AWS (for RCA/ debugging), Cloud/SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with JIRA for incident/release management.
  • Experience with validation and UAT in regulated environments.

Tools & Technologies:

  • PV systems: Argus, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety.

title: Senior Front-End Developer (Angular | TypeScript | AWS)
description:
Role: Senior Front-End Developer (Angular)

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location : 100% Remote


Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Front-End Developer with strong expertise in Angular (v19+) to design and build scalable, high-performing web applications. The role requires hands-on front-end development, UI optimization, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive user experiences.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop responsive, user-friendly interfaces using Angular best practices.
  • Optimize front-end performance and ensure code quality through testing and reviews.
  • Collaborate on backend integrations (GraphQL, Apollo) and cloud-based deployments (AWS).
  • Support production issues, identify bugs, and enforce design patterns.
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Figma AI) to accelerate workflows.


Must-Have Skills:

  • 5+ years front-end experience, including Angular (19+).
  • Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript.
  • Experience with Spring Boot, Tailwind/SaaS, Micro Frontend architecture.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Agile, and performance optimization.
  • Experience integrating with APIs and backend systems.


Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of analytics tools (Hotjar, Google Analytics, New Relic).
  • Experience with feature management platforms.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Location: San Francisco, CA, US (Remote)

Job Type: Full-Time



1. About the Role

We’re a fast-growing platform connecting Silicon Valley startups with remote tech professionals ready to step in where they’re needed most. Our technology helps engineers secure properly paid, innovative products—and helps startups build provide excellent products with confidence.


As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you’ll play a key role in building the tech that powers this mission. You'll work across the entire stack, shaping features that directly impact lives.



2. Responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end development of scalable web features using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)
  • Write clean, maintainable code across both front-end and back-end systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including designers, product managers, and mobile engineers—to build seamless experiences
  • Architect and implement efficient APIs and database structures to support performance at scale
  • Lead by example through code reviews, mentoring, and thoughtful technical decision-making

3. Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Deep experience building full-stack applications with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js
  • Comfortable working in distributed teams and following remote-first workflows

4. Nice to Haves

  • Experience with U.S.-based startups or fast-paced tech environments
  • Background in healthtech or other impact-driven platforms
  • Familiarity with mobile integration or React Native projects

5. Benefits

  • Competitive USD-based compensation
  • Work remotely with top-tier Silicon Valley-caliber teams
  • Long-term projects that drive meaningful impact
  • Collaborate with world-class talent across time zones
  • Space to grow, lead, and innovate at every level

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Somos mais que um supermercado!


A startup que já economizou mais de R$ 30 milhões a milhares de brasileiros e dobra de tamanho a cada 3 meses, desde sua fundação (em 2015). Em 2021 conseguimos levantar cerca de R$300 milhões em duas rodadas de investimento com gente fora da curva, como José Galló (ex-CEO da Renner), GIC, Ariel Lambrecht (fundador da 99 e da Yellow), Minerva Foods, entre outros. Acreditamos que um país melhor é feito de empresas mais eficientes e de pessoas que trocam velhos hábitos por escolhas mais inteligentes. E trabalhamos por isso. Por essa visão de país melhor, aplicada ao setor que atinge a todos os brasileiros: o setor de produtos essenciais de consumo, mais conhecido como "setor supermercadista". Mas esqueça esse nome: "supermercado". Somos mais que isso. Somos um sistema de reabastecimento. E queremos ser o maior e melhor sistema de reabastecimento do Brasil. Esse é nosso sonho. "Um mundo onde os produtos essenciais cheguem na sua casa com a mesma facilidade que a água chega na torneira".


Quer participar desse sonho com a gente?


Sobre o Papel


Estamos procurando um(a) pessoa Desenvolvedor Full Stack Web - Sênior para desenvolver soluções de alto desempenho. Neste papel, você deve ter habilidades de comunicação e possuir capacidade de priorizar o seu próprio trabalho. Você garantirá que nossas aplicações e sistemas funcionem corretamente e tenham um bom desempenho. A posição é aplicável para trabalhar de maneira remota para os candidatos que residem fora na cidade de São Paulo. Para os candidatos que estão na cidade de São Paulo, a posição seria híbrida, para ir 3x na semana presencial.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e implementar funcionalidades alinhadas aos requisitos e objetivos definidos pelas áreas de negócio;
  • Identificar, diagnosticar e corrigir bugs reportados pelas áreas de negócio, assegurando a estabilidade e a confiabilidade do sistema;
  • Analisar os requisitos de negócio em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de melhoria no sistema;
  • Colaborar na elaboração do planejamento técnico para a implementação dos requisitos, incluindo a definição de arquitetura, ferramentas e abordagens de desenvolvimento adequadas;
  • Monitorar continuamente o desempenho e a disponibilidade da aplicação, identificando proativamente eventuais falhas, gargalos ou inconsistências para garantir seu pleno funcionamento e minimizar interrupções;
  • Elaborar e manter a documentação detalhada de todas as soluções implementadas, incluindo descrições técnicas, mudanças realizadas e justificativas, para facilitar a manutenção, futuras atualizações e a consulta por outras equipes;
  • Participação em reuniões de planejamento e revisão utilizando metodologia Scrum.


Qualificações

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimentos em ReactJS, NodeJS e Python;
  • Conhecimento básico de arquitetura de software;
  • Familiaridade com Git e GitHub;
  • Experiência em trabalhar com metodologia Scrum;
  • Desejável: Conhecimento em serviços da AWS.
